headline: RapWire 24/7: Five distinct stories — Sept. 24, 2026 — 5 PM Pacific
body: This verified five-slide RapWire news carousel covers five distinct current stories: Macklemore’s Free Palestine benefit tour; Common’s Jefferey Park wine launch; Beenie Man’s riddim-politics comments; the Trey Songz settlement-funds dispute; and Young Thug’s Primal venture. Each story is separately sourced, visually identified, and labeled with context and attribution.

caption:
1) Macklemore announced a new Free Palestine benefit tour after being removed from Ed Sheeran’s Loop Tour over pro-Palestinian comments. The planned shows will send proceeds to organizations supporting Palestinians, extending his response from one disputed stage moment into a dedicated aid effort. [AP](https://apnews.com/article/86707774c871890552d3eaca3b404d73f) @Macklemore
2) Common launched Jefferey Park, a limited-production Pinot Noir made with winemaker Karim Mussi and Gopuff. The brand is named for the South Side Chicago park near his childhood home and is now available in select markets. [Gopuff](https://www.gopuff.com/gb/newsroom/company-news/common-debuts-jefferey-park-a-new-wine-brand-crafted-in-partnership-with-renowned-winemaker-karim-mussi-and-gopuff) @Common
3) Beenie Man says producer politics and artist alliances are changing who gets heard on dancehall riddims. His comments matter because riddim culture depends on many voices sharing a production framework, and the veteran is warning that competition can narrow that exchange. [AllHipHop](https://allhiphop.com/news/beenie-man-says-producer-politics-are-hurting-dancehalls-riddim-culture/) @KingBeenieman
4) Jauhara Jeffries is asking a Florida court to release part of the confidential settlement tied to her 2021 civil case against Trey Songz. The money remains in court-controlled escrow over a lien issue; the court denied immediate access and scheduled a later hearing. [TMZ](https://www.tmz.com/2026/09/18/trey-songz-alleged-sexual-assault-victim-wants-a-big-portion-of-settlement-money/) @TreySongz
5) Young Thug launched Primal, a creative holding company built to create, acquire and scale ventures with artists, athletes and creators. The model emphasizes ownership and long-term upside rather than one-off endorsements, putting the Atlanta rapper into a wider creator-economy lane. [Music Universe](https://themusicuniverse.com/young-thug-launches-primal/) @YoungThug

@Rapwire247
